As approved in the Finance Committee meeting held on 06.03.2026 (Vide Agernda item no. 71.1 ), an
amount of Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees lhirty lhousand ) only will be given as Festival Advance to all
permanent employees (Teaching , Officers,Non- Teaching ) of RBU for the current Year 2026. The
said Festival Advance will be disbursed from Cash Section of the Finance department from
18-09-2026 to 13-10-2026. This amount will be recovered from the salary of the concerned employee
in 10 (Ten) equal monthly instalments without any interest starting from the month of November,
Date: 09-09-2026
All concerned are kindly requested to bring the matter to the notice of the concerned employees.
